svg.aria-label: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: the interface design
svg.title: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: the interface design

g.text: F126.4 flips, re-grade and better or worse: the interface design
the note, Flip to met, Don't flip

text.tspan: A flip sits on its mark, and every sum on the run asks the mark which answer counts. One rule says when a mark carries over, for a re-grade and a replay. The re-grader makes a new run from a graded one. A run compares itself with
another, and the eval's run list says which run is the run before. The number is the step; violet is there already and unchanged.
